purchasePathNote: Agility sells Digit through its sales team, mainly as Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) where Agility keeps ownership and charges a monthly fee. Its investor presentation also mentions outright purchase with a deployment fee. No public list price.

configurations.name: Digit RaaS (per robot, per month)
configurations.notes: Illustrative figure in Agility's investor presentation dated October 6, 2026: '$8,500 monthly RaaS pricing per Digit', plus about $25,000 one-time deployment fee. Actual terms depend on each customer agreement.

configurations.name: Digit (outright purchase)
configurations.notes: The investor presentation mentions upfront purchase plus a one-time ~$20,000 deployment fee but does not state the robot's purchase price.

sellers.name: Agility Robotics sales
sellers.offers: No price shown. 'Deploy Digit' contact form: 'Our team can help you find the right configuration for your operation.'

rental.name: Agility Robotics RaaS
rental.notes: Sales-led Robots-as-a-Service contracts. GXO signed a multi-year RaaS agreement for Digit after a pilot. Investor materials use $8,500 per robot per month as an illustrative rate.

priceHistory.event: Investor presentation uses $8,500 per month RaaS pricing per Digit (illustrative)

faq.a: Only through Agility's sales team, mostly as a Robots-as-a-Service contract. There is no public order page or list price.
Agility has not published a list price. Its October 2026 investor presentation uses $8,500 per robot per month for RaaS, plus about $25,000 one-time deployment fee, as an illustrative figure.

faq.q: Is Digit priced at $30 an hour?
faq.a: No. CEO Peggy Johnson cited a fully loaded human labor cost of $30 an hour as the benchmark for an under-2-year return on investment. It is not Digit's rental rate.
GXO deploys Digit in logistics under a multi-year RaaS agreement.

notes: All pricing is from investor materials and is illustrative, not a quote. Expect per-deployment terms, a deployment fee and site integration costs. Digit v5 was launched in September 2026; pricing may differ by generation.
